findings.highlight: I can’t pierce Saber’s heart.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの胸を貫かない
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s trembling hand never drives the dagger into Saber’s chest.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the intended bodily target to the heart, adding lethal anatomical precision.

findings.highlight: without emotion or interest
findings.evidenceJa: 対岸の火を見るように
findings.governingReading: Saber watches mounted Shirou as detachedly as a fire on the opposite shore.
findings.explanation: The English retains emotional distance but removes the culturally concrete simile of remote unconcern.

findings.highlight: clear, golden hair
findings.evidenceJa: 鮮やかな金の髪
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls Saber’s vivid golden hair.
findings.explanation: “Clear hair” is unnatural and mistranslates vivid color.

findings.highlight: her silver armor and the beauty of her attacks
findings.evidenceJa: 翻る銀の甲冑、振るわれる一撃の美しさ
findings.governingReading: He vividly recalls silver armor flashing or turning and the beauty of one sword stroke.
findings.explanation: The English removes the armor’s motion and pluralizes the singular exemplary blow into generic attacks.

findings.highlight: serving as my sword to the very end
findings.evidenceJa: 最期まで俺の剣であってくれた
findings.governingReading: Saber willingly remained Shirou’s sword through the very end.
findings.explanation: “Serving as” retains function but weakens the benefactive, chosen constancy in `してくれた`.

findings.highlight: The golden hair shining under the moonlight.
findings.evidenceJa: 月の光に濡れた金の髪
findings.governingReading: Saber’s golden hair appears wet or drenched in moonlight.
findings.explanation: “Shining under” flattens the tactile saturated image into ordinary illumination.

findings.highlight: An eternal scene
findings.evidenceJa: 切り取られた、永遠の風景
findings.governingReading: The moonlit memory is a cut-out, isolated eternal scene untouched by later transformation.
findings.explanation: The English keeps eternity but removes the image of one moment severed and preserved from time.

findings.highlight: she has turned dark
findings.evidenceJa: 見る影もなく黒く変色し
findings.governingReading: Saber has discolored black beyond any trace of her former appearance.
findings.explanation: The English retains dark transformation but removes the total loss of recognizable former appearance.

findings.highlight: onto the ground
findings.evidenceJa: 乾いた地面に突き刺さる
findings.governingReading: The dropped dagger sticks into dry ground rather than Saber’s chest.
findings.explanation: The English removes dryness and weakens penetration into merely falling onto the ground.

findings.highlight: Her body’s completely healed now.
findings.evidenceJa: 刻一刻と回復していた体は、もう完全に復元していた
findings.governingReading: Saber’s body, recovering moment by moment, has now been completely restored.
findings.explanation: The English retains completion but removes the visible progressive interval that makes Shirou’s delay fatal.

findings.highlight: her magical energy is charged as well
findings.evidenceJa: 消費した魔力すら元通り
findings.governingReading: Even Saber’s expended magical energy has returned to its original level.
findings.explanation: “Charged” gives no prior-state comparison and can imply merely having some energy rather than full restoration.

findings.highlight: The person causing the rumbling is frantically calling for help?
findings.evidenceJa: この振動を起こしている“誰か”が、必死に助けを求めている？
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively asks whether some unknown “someone” causing the vibration is desperately seeking help.
findings.explanation: The English presupposes an actual person and weakens the marked uncertainty around the agent.

findings.highlight: it seeps into the rock
findings.evidenceJa: 地面に染み込むように
findings.governingReading: Saber’s shadow disappears as though soaking into the ground.
findings.explanation: The English changes the surface into rock, adding a material the source does not specify.

findings.highlight: I realize I’m sleeping in an unfamiliar place.
findings.evidenceJa: 膝を立てて眠っていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou discovers himself asleep with his knees raised in an unfamiliar place.
findings.explanation: The English removes the exact seated or curled posture in which he awakens.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to suppress Archer’s arm after that.
findings.evidenceJa: その後は何をしても、アーチャーの腕を抑えきれなくなる
findings.governingReading: After one more Projection, Shirou will be unable to suppress Archer’s arm whatever he does.
findings.explanation: The English preserves failure but removes its absolute, unavoidable scope.

findings.highlight: a tin man
findings.evidenceJa: ブリキで出来た人形
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels like a doll made of tin.
findings.explanation: “Tin man” changes the object and imports an external character association absent from the bodily image.

findings.highlight: Someone’s calling for me in the distance.
findings.evidenceJa: とおくでだれかが呼んでいる
findings.governingReading: Someone is calling in the distance; the addressee is not yet stated.
findings.explanation: The English adds that the caller is specifically calling for Shirou.

findings.highlight: A warm wind that makes me want to vomit
findings.evidenceJa: 生温かい、吐き気を催す風
findings.governingReading: Only a lukewarm, nauseating wind flows from deeper inside.
findings.explanation: “Warm” loses the clammy bodily unpleasantness of `生温かい`.

findings.highlight: My brain shreds a little more with each step, and my thoughts are crumbling apart like a collapsing building.
findings.evidenceJa: 脳は切り刻まれ、倒壊するビルのように、思考能力が削られていく
findings.governingReading: Each step cuts Shirou’s brain apart while his capacity for thought is scraped away like a collapsing building.
findings.explanation: The English makes the brain shred itself and transfers the building-collapse image from declining cognitive capacity to thoughts themselves.

findings.highlight: The heat burns my lungs
findings.evidenceJa: 肌を焦がすほどの猛熱
findings.governingReading: The fierce heat is strong enough to scorch Shirou’s skin.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the heat injury from exterior skin to the lungs.

findings.highlight: inside a giant stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 生き物の消化器官
findings.governingReading: The cavern resembles the digestive organs of a living creature.
findings.explanation: The English invents giant scale and narrows an organ system to a stomach.

findings.highlight: where Sakura hid herself
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が閉じ篭り
findings.governingReading: Sakura has shut herself away at the final destination.
findings.explanation: “Hid herself” emphasizes concealment rather than withdrawal and confinement.

findings.highlight: Everything’s so intensely white that I can’t find
findings.evidenceJa: 白く煙って見つからない
findings.governingReading: Zouken, Rin, and Sakura cannot be found through the white smoky haze.
findings.explanation: The English removes smoke or haze and instead makes whiteness itself intense.

findings.highlight: My thoughts are a precious resource right now.
findings.evidenceJa: 思考は回数制になっている
findings.governingReading: Shirou can now perform only a finite number of acts of thought.
findings.explanation: The English conveys scarcity but removes the chilling count-limited mechanism.

findings.highlight: looks at me with wonder
findings.evidenceJa: 不思議そうに、本当に不思議そうに
findings.governingReading: Sakura looks at Shirou in puzzlement—genuinely, unmistakably puzzled.
findings.explanation: The English removes the repetition that stresses her reaction is authentic rather than performed.

findings.highlight: The coldness of her eyes brings everything to a halt.
findings.evidenceJa: その冷たさに胸を突かれて、声をあげる事が出来なかった
findings.governingReading: Struck in the chest by the coldness, Shirou cannot raise his voice.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes a specific emotional blow and loss of speech into everything stopping.

findings.highlight: arrange them at the exit
findings.evidenceJa: 出口にいっぱい配置した
findings.governingReading: Sakura says she placed many manifestations at the exit to surprise Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English preserves plural placement but removes their large number.

findings.highlight: She smiles.
findings.evidenceJa: くすり、と笑う。
findings.governingReading: Sakura gives a small laugh before Shirou’s spine freezes.
findings.explanation: The English replaces audible laughter with a smile.

findings.highlight: I look around the cavern from here.
findings.evidenceJa: 崖の上から空洞を一望する
findings.governingReading: From atop the cliff, Shirou takes in the entire cavern at a glance.
findings.explanation: The English removes the elevated viewpoint and comprehensive survey.

findings.highlight: A cloth that looks like a ribbon is on the ground, dyed in black.
findings.evidenceJa: 黒く染まった地面には、黒い、リボンのような布きれ
findings.governingReading: A black ribbon-like scrap lies on ground stained black.
findings.explanation: The English attaches the black dye to the cloth rather than the ground, reversing the local modifier relation.

findings.highlight: I finished every bit of her body and mind.
findings.evidenceJa: 体も心も、残さずキレイに
findings.governingReading: Sakura claims she left neither body nor mind behind and cleaned everything away with proper manners.
findings.explanation: The English turns grotesque tidiness into a direct claim of eating every bit, narrowing the mechanism beyond her wording.

findings.highlight: So she was a virgin.
findings.evidenceJa: 姉さん、あんなに弱かったんですね
findings.governingReading: Sakura remarks that Rin proved surprisingly weak under the replicated suffering.
findings.explanation: The mature English branch replaces comparative weakness with an unsupported sexual-status claim.

findings.highlight: The person you brought me was a delicious treat.
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩が連れてきてくれた食材は、最高のご馳走でした
findings.governingReading: Sakura thanks Shirou for bringing an “ingredient” that became the finest feast.
findings.explanation: The English preserves food imagery but removes the staged ingredient-to-banquet transformation and its formal gratitude.

findings.highlight: My remaining thoughts ignite.
findings.evidenceJa: 残った思考回路が破裂していく
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s remaining thought circuits progressively burst apart.
findings.explanation: The English changes neurological rupture into thoughts catching fire.

findings.highlight: I’m starting to forget
findings.evidenceJa: 判らなくなっていく
findings.governingReading: Shirou progressively loses the ability to understand his task and the person before him.
findings.explanation: The English changes active comprehension failure into ordinary forgetting.

findings.highlight: You went too far, too far away for me to retrieve you.
findings.evidenceJa: もう、俺では取り戻せないところに、
findings.governingReading: The source breaks off after “to a place where I can no longer bring [her] back,” withholding subject and completed predicate.
findings.explanation: The English completes the fragment, directly accuses Sakura, and invents repeated evaluative “too far.”

findings.highlight: I’ll swallow you too.
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩も一緒に取り込んであげます
findings.governingReading: Sakura offers to take or incorporate Shirou inside along with Rin.
findings.explanation: “Swallow” narrows the ominous assimilation mechanism to ingestion.

findings.highlight: Nee-san’s been asking for your help.
findings.evidenceJa: さっきから先輩に助けを求めてばっかり
findings.governingReading: Rin has done nothing but plead to Shirou for rescue continuously since earlier.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the plea but removes its duration and exclusive repetition.

findings.highlight: becoming a tidal wave that surges over me
findings.evidenceJa: 津波となって俺を呑み込んだ
findings.governingReading: The merged giants become a tsunami and swallow Shirou.
findings.explanation: “Surges over” weakens total engulfment into surface passage.

findings.highlight: I hear someone weeping
findings.evidenceJa: 泣き叫ぶ誰かの声が、聞こえた気がした
findings.governingReading: As Shirou falls, he feels as though he heard somewhere the voice of someone crying out and screaming.
findings.explanation: The English makes the hearing certain, removes distance and screaming, and weakens the unresolved identity cue.
